# Featured Engineering Projects

> Highlights of software engineering and cloud infrastructure projects by Maanasa Narayan.

- [Projects Section](https://maanasa.dev/#projects)
- [Main LLMs Reference](https://maanasa.dev/llms.txt)

## Projects List

- **Airline Integration Microservices (Kayak):** High-throughput Java services for flight search, availability, seat maps, and bookings with automated CI/CD and Kibana monitoring.
- **Bug Bash Tool (Amazon):** React and Node.js automation platform deployed on AWS Lambda for Amazon's Choice badge validation; saved ~20 engineering hours per release.
- **Stock Trader Platform (MERN):** Full-stack financial platform with role-based access control and real-time market data integration.
- **Interactive Adventure Game (Java):** MVC Swing game with 100+ unit and integration tests in JUnit.
